facts.claim: In 1835 a grant of Rs. 1,500 was sanctioned by Government for the restoration of the delapidated church at Virajpet.
facts.quote: In 1835 a grant of Rs. 1,500 was sanctioned by Government for the restoration of the delapidated church at Virajpet

facts.claim: In 1866 a new grant of Rs. 2,500 was given for re-building the same church, which after completion is said to have cost Rs. 15,000.
facts.quote: and in 1866 a new grant of Rs. 2,500 for re-building the same edifice, which after comple- tion is said to have cost Rs. 1 5,000

facts.claim: The number of Roman Catholic Christians in Virajpet amounts to 313.
facts.quote: The number of Roman Catholic Christians in Virajpet amounts to 313
